clips.caption:
The fastest way to spot someone who hasn't actually arrived is listen for the word "invented."

Someone genuinely evolved says, I discovered a method, it seems to help most people. Someone running on ego says, I invented this, it's mine, nobody did this before me. One is humble because they know they don't have full certainty. The other is claiming ownership of something that was never theirs to own in the first place, and that claim is the tell.
